title.narrative: UNICEF’s support to the National Case Management System and Victim-Friendly System resulted in27,134 children (16,552 girls and 10,582 boys) benefiting from child protection services with support from partners in health, social work, and justice/law enforcement services. A total of3,070children benefited from birth registration support services in target districts and19,280parents and caregivers benefited from childcare awarenessandgender transformative parenting programmes. In partnership with Zimbabwe Parents of Handicapped Children Association (ZPHCA), 811 children with disabilities (386 girls and 425 boys) accessedsocial services.
